items.title: Harold Ousley interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: in fact Yusef Lateef used to play at a club on the west side.

ctx.x: That’s funny. I guess that was a good training ground too for young musicians.

It was. Because you got a chance to hear everybody. Because even if you didn’t get a chance to hear musicians in some of the clubs. Because they had — even on the west side, they had — in fact Yusef Lateef used to play at a club on the west side. You know but on a Monday you would see all the musicians like this because everybody would hang out for gigs and just hear everybody else that played.
So this was what years in particular for you?
